evidence.title: TRACE: A Self-Evolving Skill Bank for Consistent, Limit-Aware LLM Agents

summary: A new framework called TRACE enables large language model agents to autonomously evolve their skills while maintaining consistency and awareness of their limitations. The system aims to improve adaptability and reliability in AI-driven tasks.
title: Researchers Introduce TRACE: A Self-Evolving Skill Bank for Advanced LLM Agents
